title: CSV rerun pending publish hardening
summary: Hardened CSV rerun pending-publish writes outside the direct-final-publish mode: rerun promotion now writes a pending_move manifest before media movement, updates to parked after movement, carries known sidecar/subtitle evidence, and rejects original source mutation policies.
reason: Review found that CSV rerun pending-publish writers could move payloads before durable manifest intent existed, could drop sidecar evidence, and could allow source-original policies after direct publish.
behavior_before: CSV rerun pending-publish and rerun promote wrote manifests after moving media, represented sidecar/subtitle evidence as empty arrays, and allowed original source mutation policies when strict confirmations were supplied.
behavior_after: CSV rerun pending-publish and rerun promote write pending_move manifests before media movement, update parked state after movement, preserve known sibling SRT sidecars and sidecar evidence, and fail closed for original source mutation policies.
rollback_plan: Revert the touched rerun policy/results, Invoke-RerunCsv.ps1, tests, route-contract docs, generated summaries, and this change packet. Re-run the same focused Python and PowerShell validation commands.
